title: Independently pinned read-only native outcome lookup configuration
description: Closed canonical sorted compact ASCII JSON without LF, at most 8192 bytes. Requires explicit --inspect-native-outcome CLI selection and independently pinned root-owned owner-only single-link original. Actual protected journal chain and root:root0700 directory identity are retained under a shared nonblocking flock. A separate at-most-five-second read-only allowance never renews a writer, contacts a provider, starts a child, issues cleanup or repairs history.
